Wait carbonyl adds O, so C7H7NO? plus O? Actually carbonyl O is counted, so C7H7NO? That's missing O. Should be C7H7NO? I'm confused.

Better approach: Use tool search_by_smiles with formula? But we don't have SMILES. Could generate possible fragments? Given we have aromatic carbons 6, carbonyl 1, CH3 1, total C10. So aromatic ring (C6) plus carbonyl carbon (C1) plus CH3 carbon (C1) plus maybe a carbon attached to N (C1) and maybe another carbon (C1). Could be something like 4-methyl-3-nitro? No N present.

Maybe the compound is 4-methyl-3-oxobutanamide? Not.
